name: cursor-pagination-lab
description: Lab bài 01/02: Keyset (cursor) pagination cho lịch sử giao dịch trên PostgreSQL 16 — OFFSET so với truy vấn seek, cursor mờ có ký HMAC, frontend useInfiniteQuery

scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d ledger -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v rows=${ROWS:-20000000} -v merchants=${MERCHANTS:-1000} -v big=10 -v big_share=0.3 -f /lab/db/seed-transactions.sql
scripts.db:index: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d ledger -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /lab/db/add-keyset-index.sql
scripts.db:unindex: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d ledger -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /lab/db/drop-keyset-index.sql
